svg.title: Сгибание рук на низком блоке обратным хватом — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing reverse-grip low cable curl. Repeat the same complete compact cable machine just in front of the person within each half. Its pulley is at ankle level. One taut cable from pulley to midpoint of a short straight bar held in BOTH hands. LEFT arms almost straight at thighs, knuckles on top, palms facing down toward floor. RIGHT both elbows curl while staying beside ribs, bar rises toward upper abdomen, hands remain clearly pronated with backs of hands facing up and toward body. No loose barbell plates and no rope. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
